Data

The data is unemployment rates across the country (USA) and some specific states. It comes from the St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank (FRED) between the years 1976 - 2026.

Visualization

The graph above is showing the unemployment rate over time for the different states/the entire country on one graph.

The graph above shows the employment rate over time for the different states/the entire country on separate graphs.

The graph above shows the average unemployment rate from 1976 to 2026 for the different states/the entire country.

For this graph I used the unemp_covid data frame, which filters the unemployment data to only include the year 2020. This allows us to focus on the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on unemployment rates across different regions. You can notice that New York pea after everyone else.

Reflection

The coding was pretty straightforward for the most part, but formatting the quarto document is a bit tedious. I forgot about echo and was wondering why my code was showing. I feel pretty comfortable committing and pushing to github now. I need to work more with github to get fully comfortable with it.
